title: NewtonMeshCollisionAPI (hull vertex limit fallback)
summary: Newton hull vertex limit, read for convexHull and convexDecomposition approximations when the matching PhysX hullVertexLimit is absent.
producer_scope: Published like any applied API when the Newton schema is registered for population; without the registration its attributes are lost (see the ovphysx Newton schema notes).

columns.name: newton:maxHullVertices
columns.absent: No override: the PhysX hull vertex limit, else the cooking default, stands.
columns.notes: Newton schema attribute (newton-usd-schemas, not shipped with ovphysx). Read for convexHull and convexDecomposition approximations when the matching PhysX hullVertexLimit is absent; a value > 0 becomes the hull vertex limit.

notes: The parser reads these columns without checking that NewtonMeshCollisionAPI is listed in usd-schemas. The compiled cache reads them but does not support the API: a prim that lists NewtonMeshCollisionAPI makes the cache bypass.

Newton's schema makes NewtonCollisionAPI and PhysicsMeshCollisionAPI built-ins of this API, and USD population lists built-ins among a prim's applied schemas. The builder writes only what the caller applies, so it requires them on the same prim instead of writing a prim the walker would not recognize.
